classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

ownership.note: Phase 10 owns delivery: conversations, channels, templates, delivery state, provider routing, and the Communication Steward's mandate machine. Identity is Phase 02's, tenancy Phase 03's, execution primitives Phase 05's, the workspace shell Phase 06's, the agent runtime Phase 07's, authorization Phase 08's, provenance and retention Phase 09's, and every domain meaning belongs to the phase that owns it. The steward owns decisions, never domain rules, and it never trusts a client-supplied tenant, role or contact identity.

areas.area: Organization subscription to platform communication
areas.requirement: An organization with a tenant and a name is provisioned with a communication subscription and a steward; provisioning without either is refused; seat entitlement follows the plan.

areas.area: A new organization's steward starts inert
areas.requirement: Provisioning creates the mandate in OBSERVE with no channels, audiences, jurisdictions, languages or knowledge topics, and every action is refused until the organization opens authority.

areas.area: The autonomy ladder decides act, ask or step aside
areas.requirement: OBSERVE never acts, DRAFT drafts and reports presence only, APPROVAL_REQUIRED queues every person-facing action for a human, and AUTONOMOUS acts alone within the mandate; answering or placing a call requires AUTONOMOUS.

areas.area: Mass communication is witnessed by a human
areas.requirement: Mass communication requires human approval at every autonomy level, and the decision asks for a recipient estimate and a preview.

areas.area: Sensitive classifications need an accountable human
areas.requirement: CONFIDENTIAL and RESTRICTED communication requires human approval at every autonomy level.

areas.area: A steward may never hold highly restricted material
areas.requirement: HIGHLY_RESTRICTED is refused outright, before any other question is asked.

areas.area: The mandate opens the channels
areas.requirement: An action on a channel the mandate never opened is refused, and the refusal names the rule.

areas.area: The mandate opens the audiences
areas.requirement: An action addressed to an audience outside the mandate is refused.

areas.area: Reach outside the organization is explicit
areas.requirement: Communication with an external recipient is refused unless the mandate permits it.

areas.area: Jurisdiction is never inferred
areas.requirement: A contact whose jurisdiction is unknown is refused, and one outside the mandate is refused with the jurisdiction named.

areas.area: A language the steward does not hold is handed to a human
areas.requirement: An action in a language outside the mandate escalates to a human instead of proceeding.

areas.area: A person's instruction is absolute
areas.requirement: A do-not-contact entry refuses the action, and the decision carries the duty to honour the opt-out; marketing and voice scopes are narrower than an absolute instruction.

areas.area: Marketing needs a recorded, attributable opt-in
areas.requirement: Marketing is refused without a recorded opt-in for that channel; an opt-in without a source, without a subject, or for an emergency purpose is refused at creation.

areas.area: Emergency communication needs explicit authority
areas.requirement: Emergency communication is refused unless the mandate grants it, and an authorised emergency is not silenced by quiet hours.

areas.area: Outside its knowledge pack the steward escalates
areas.requirement: A topic the pack does not cover, or the mandate has not opened, escalates to a human instead of being answered.

areas.area: A prohibited topic is refused, never negotiated
areas.requirement: A topic the organization prohibited is refused before any other question is weighed.

areas.area: Volume and spend ceilings are hard
areas.requirement: A reached limit stops the steward and names the limit, and an approaching limit warns the owner before it bites. Money is held in minor units with a currency.

areas.area: Quiet hours bind external channels, in the mandate's timezone
areas.requirement: An external message inside the quiet window is refused, an in-app message is not, an authorised emergency is not silenced, and an unreadable clock fails closed.

areas.area: A person speaking to a machine is told so
areas.requirement: A permitted conversation obliges disclosure of the assistant where the mandate requires it or the words are machine-generated, and the duty travels with the permission.

areas.area: Recording needs permission and carries notice
areas.requirement: Recording a call is refused unless the mandate allows it, and a permitted recording carries an obligation to announce it.

areas.area: No decision is returned without its audit duty
areas.requirement: Every decision — allowed refused, gated or escalated — carries an audit obligation and a reason long enough to be actionable.

areas.area: A call follows declared states and never resumes once finished
areas.requirement: A call session starts in REQUESTED, moves only along declared transitions, refuses shortcuts to an outcome, and treats COMPLETED and ABANDONED as terminal; only COMPLETED counts as resolved.

areas.area: Escalation is always available and never a failure
areas.requirement: An unacknowledged emergency escalates within ten minutes, an urgent message within the hour, three attempts or a day of silence escalate, and escalation is permitted even when the mandate is revoked or at OBSERVE.

areas.area: A mandate is live only between creation and expiry or revocation
areas.requirement: A revoked or expired mandate refuses every action, and revocation is a timestamp rather than a deletion.

areas.area: Presence is privacy-controlled and platform-internal
areas.requirement: Presence states are online, offline and recently active; a signal is shareable only when the subject permits it, and presence never implies reachability by telephone.

areas.area: The provider catalogue describes the real market
areas.requirement: The registry names the carriers, WhatsApp, email, push, meeting, social and presence adapters the platform is designed to route through, with an operator-facing explanation, a channel list and a region list for each, and no duplicate ids.

areas.area: A provider credential is a reference, never a secret
areas.requirement: An adapter must name its credential by scheme (secret://, vault://, kms://, env://, internal://); an empty reference, a schemeless string and material that looks like a real key are all refused, and every catalogued adapter passes.

areas.area: Capability is derived from the registry, not hard-coded
areas.requirement: Every declared channel appears exactly once in the capability matrix, and each channel's provider list is derived from the adapters that claim it.

areas.area: Routing refuses rather than guessing
areas.requirement: A delivery resolves to an ACTIVE adapter for the channel and region, or is refused with the reasons and the candidates it rejected; a region a provider does not serve is never selected; a degraded provider is used only when the caller allows it; and a capability requirement that excludes every adapter is reported as such.

areas.area: Failover walks down tiers and respects regions
areas.requirement: The ladder orders primary, then regional where the region is served, then secondary; it carries only adapters that handle the channel, excludes providers that do not serve the region, and reports the health it was given.

areas.area: A provider lifecycle is a machine, not a label
areas.requirement: DISCOVERED, CONFIGURED, VALIDATED, ACTIVE, DEGRADED, SUSPENDED and RETIRED exist; validation cannot be skipped, RETIRED is terminal, only ACTIVE is usable without an explicit request, and every external adapter is DISCOVERED because no credential is provisioned.

areas.area: Mandates, consent, do-not-contact and call sessions are durable
areas.requirement: The steward mandate data model (section EM) arrives as a migration with its RLS policies, so a decision can be proved after the fact. Today the shapes exist as typed values only, and nothing persists them.

areas.area: An external message can actually be delivered
areas.requirement: At least one external adapter holds a provisioned credential and reaches ACTIVE, so SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email or push can leave the platform. Today every external adapter is DISCOVERED and routing refuses every real channel.

areas.area: A provider call is actually performed
areas.requirement: An adapter implementation performs a provider request and an inbound webhook surface receives delivery receipts and inbound messages, so failover, retry and receipts are observed rather than declared.

areas.area: The steward composes answers from the organization's material
areas.requirement: A generation path and a knowledge-pack store exist, so the steward can answer inside its pack instead of only deciding whether an action is permitted. Today the decisions are deterministic policy with no model and no pack store behind them.

areas.area: A permitted recording has storage, retention and access rules
areas.requirement: Recordings and transcripts have storage, a retention window, an access policy and a deletion path, so recording can be switched on lawfully.

areas.area: Seats and plans are enforced and billed
areas.requirement: Steward usage is metered, plan tiers are enforced and invoices are produced. Today a subscription carries a billing reference and nothing measures anything.

areas.area: Replacing a human role is decided with the people affected
areas.requirement: An organization can hand its support-and-communications role to its steward through a recorded handover. The mechanism and the record exist; the staffing decision is the organization's, and nothing performs it automatically.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
